Routine ongoing litigation accruals, procedural case updates, generic risks and unchanged business-policy recaps do not become new exclusion categories.

Court complaints and rulings bearing dates before an observation window are treated as prior public procedural events absent an indication of sealing; this is an explicit inference from the dated original report, not a comprehensive court-docket audit.
